items.name: Logo-first cold open
items.why_bad: Wastes the 0–1s thumb-stop window on identity the viewer doesn’t care about yet.
items.fix: Open on problem, confession, transformation, spectacle, or trend format; brand after second 8–12 (earlier only if brand IS the spectacle).

items.name: Feature laundry list
items.why_bad: No single job; nothing memorable; sounds like a brochure.
items.fix: One job per ad. Features become proof of the mechanism, not the headline.

items.name: Obviously fake UGC
items.why_bad: Studio lighting + teleprompter cadence + stock smile triggers distrust.
items.fix: Real handheld, real environment, imperfect takes — or lean into polished cinematic honestly (don’t fake native).

items.name: Multiple CTAs
items.why_bad: Splits action; muddies attribution; lowers conversion.
items.fix: One primary CTA per cut; variants live in the A/B matrix, not the same video.

items.name: Invented testimonials or metrics
items.why_bad: Legal and trust risk; models hallucinate social proof easily.
items.fix: Only use reviews, numbers, and awards the user provides. Otherwise use pattern-level proof structure with placeholders.

items.name: Muted-illegible text
items.why_bad: Most feed views start muted; tiny captions = dead ad.
items.fix: Assume muted. Hook must read as text or work as pure visual.

items.name: Promise mismatch on landing
items.why_bad: Kills conversion even if CTR is strong.
items.fix: Mirror hook language above the fold; same offer, same SKU, same geo.

items.name: Forced trend with no offer map
items.fix: Punchline must equal product truth, or skip the trend.

items.name: Tragedy / crisis newsjacking
items.why_bad: Brand damage and platform takedowns; unethical.
items.fix: Only ride light cultural moments you can own tastefully; never exploit harm.

items.name: Unlicensed audio, footage, or faces
items.fix: Clear sounds for paid; prefer original or licensed music; releases for faces.

items.name: Pretty film with no job-to-be-done
items.fix: Even premium_cinema needs a desire → capability → signature end. Pair with a DR twin.

items.name: Uncanny cheap CGI flex
items.why_bad: Signals low quality; hurts premium brands.
items.fix: If CGI isn’t excellent, use live macro / practical instead.

items.name: Over-scripted influencer
items.why_bad: Destroys the native advantage you paid for.
items.fix: Brief with must-say truths and do-not-say; let delivery stay theirs. FTC disclose.

items.name: Empty engagement bait
items.why_bad: Comments without commercial memory; can trip spam systems.
items.fix: Comment CTAs must unlock real utility (keyword → asset) or a real debate worth having.

items.name: Cliffhanger with no Part 2 planned
items.fix: Outline the full series before publishing Part 1.
